name: orbis-relay
description: Orbis Relay — human trust infrastructure for autonomous software

scripts.test:sdk: pnpm --filter @orbis/sdk test && python3 -m unittest discover -s packages/python-sdk/tests
scripts.ios:test: xcodebuild test -project apps/ios/OrbisRelay.xcodeproj -scheme OrbisRelay -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -derivedDataPath apps/ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=-
scripts.video: cd video/brag-output/composition && npx hyperframes render --quality delivery --output ../brag.mp4
